page_title: IPS 2-0 CHE | Ipswich v Chelsea 30/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Samy Morsy (Ipswich) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) earns the yellow card.
90+4' Kieran McKenna has decided to make a change. Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) replaces Liam Delap.
90+4' It's time for a substitution. Jack Taylor (Ipswich) comes on in place of Omari Hutchinson.

90+3' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
88' The main referee, John Brooks, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Levi Colwill (Chelsea) is given a yellow card for dissent.
88' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
88' Leif Davis (Ipswich) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
86' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Wes Burns is replaced by Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich).
83' A yellow-coloured card is received by Liam Delap (Ipswich).
82' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
80' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Christian Walton comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Here is a change. Jens Cajuste is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich).
77' The substitution is prepared. Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nathan Broadhead.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is coming onto the pitch as Noni Madueke cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Malo Gusto (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch so that Axel Disasi can be given a rest.
77' The game is interrupted as Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is flagged offside.
76' The corner from Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) is hurriedly cleared.

76' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball is out of play. Ipswich will have a chance to score from a corner.
75' Wes Burns (Ipswich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ipswich are going to take it.

74' Liam Delap (Ipswich) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the top right corner, but Filip Jorgensen makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. Ipswich will take a corner kick.
73' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
73' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Chelsea.
71' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
70' Surely that's handball by one of the Ipswich players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
69' Liam Delap (Ipswich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
69' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
69' Shots on target – 5:5.

67' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' Chelsea couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Christian Walton (Ipswich) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
65' A substitution has been made. Christopher Nkunku goes off and Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) comes on.
64' The ball is cleared after Noni Madueke (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
63' Liam Delap (Ipswich) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
62' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends the corner into the box, but Christian Walton intercepts it and averts the threat.
62' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
61' A cross from Noni Madueke (Chelsea) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
59' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
57' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
55' Here comes a substitution. Joao Felix is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea).
53' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) receives a precise pass inside the box from Liam Delap and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
51' Christian Walton comes off his line to intercept the corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea).

51' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.

50' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Christian Walton is alert and denies him with a nice save. Chelsea have a corner.
48' Joao Felix (Chelsea) plants a goal-bound header towards the left post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' John Brooks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.

45+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball into the roof of the net, but an amazing dive from the goalkeeper denies him. The strike bounces off his gloves and crashes against the bar! Chelsea get a corner.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Noni Madueke (Chelsea), but the defence gets it clear.
43' 5:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
42' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
40' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

39' Liam Delap (Ipswich) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ipswich.
36' Joao Felix (Chelsea) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Christian Walton.
35' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.
33' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
32' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

30' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
29' The possession of the ball – 29:71.
27' The goal by Chelsea won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
25' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Chelsea players aren’t happy.
24' It's a goal! Joao Felix (Chelsea) scores with a brilliant shot into the top left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Cole Palmer. The score is now 1:1.
23' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea).

22' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) gets on the end of a cross and fires in a shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the left post. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
20' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) brings his opponent down with a tackle and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
19' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends a chip pass into the box, but Christian Walton is quickest to intercept the ball.
16' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
14' Liam Delap (Ipswich) volleys the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his shot by pulling off a wonderful save.
12' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Liam Delap (Ipswich) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Filip Jorgensen no chance!
12' Liam Delap (Ipswich) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
11' Referee John Brooks is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Ipswich!
11' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Ipswich as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
10' John Brooks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Filip Jorgensen (Chelsea) brought his opponent down. A penalty is given to Ipswich!
9' Neat passing move from Chelsea in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
4' What a great touch by Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
2' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
1' Leif Davis (Ipswich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Ipswich will kick the game off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
